subject.title: [Bug]: Isolated cron agentTurn fails with 'setup timed out before runner start' — all fallback models exhausted on 2026.5.12

question: Should OpenClaw accept the bounded job-timeout-derived setup watchdog in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96219 as the canonical fix for this issue's generic pre-runner setup timeout?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but choosing the default setup window is a product and availability tradeoff because longer setup tolerance helps slow cold starts while holding cron capacity longer when setup is genuinely stuck.

options.title: Accept bounded setup window
options.body: Merge or sponsor the PR's 60s floor, half-timeout, 10m-cap policy as the default fix for generic isolated cron setup timeouts.

options.title: Tighten the cap first
options.body: Ask for a lower cap or additional live cron-capacity proof before accepting longer stuck-setup occupancy.

options.title: Prefer explicit configurability
options.body: Reject the default-policy change and require an operator config knob or a separate tuning design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded setup window
recommendation.body: Merge or sponsor the PR's 60s floor, half-timeout, 10m-cap policy as the default fix for generic isolated cron setup timeouts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent owner-boundary history in the cron watchdog module and is the best available routing candidate for the product-level setup-window policy choice.
